requirements.title: IPARITY argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range 1 through the rank of ARRAY; MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.

requirements.definition: For rank-one ARRAY the DIM form equals the no-DIM form; for higher rank, each result element equals IPARITY of the corresponding vector section along DIM, with the corresponding MASK section applied when MASK is present.
